page.layout: One printed page: a numbered list of chapter titles in the upper left, a catchword-like word "DE" at the right below the list; faint show-through text in the lower half is not printed text.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page (faint lines in the lower half) is omitted. The numbers 20–33 are set in a decorative old-style figure form and are copied as their values. The "DE" at the right is a catchword-like signal word, so it is also given as the final line; the handwritten-looking marks at the foot are stains. The long s is rendered as s throughout.
